title.en: Journal entries for issue for cash

body.en: When the whole amount is payable on application: (1) Bank A/c Dr, To Debenture Application and Allotment A/c; (2) Debenture Application and Allotment A/c Dr, To X% Debentures A/c (face value), To Securities Premium A/c (premium, if any). For a discount, debit Discount on *Issue* of Debentures A/c in entry (2). Excess application money is refunded or adjusted.
body.kn: ಸ್ವೀಕರಿಸಿದ ಹಣವನ್ನು ಮೊದಲು ಸಾಲಪತ್ರ ಅರ್ಜಿ ಮತ್ತು ಹಂಚಿಕೆ ಖಾತೆಗೆ ಜಮಾ ಮಾಡಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ನಂತರ ಮುಖಬೆಲೆಯನ್ನು ಸಾಲಪತ್ರ ಖಾತೆಗೆ, ಅಧಿಮೌಲ್ಯವನ್ನು ಸೆಕ್ಯುರಿಟೀಸ್ ಪ್ರೀಮಿಯಂ ಖಾತೆಗೆ ಜಮಾ ಮಾಡಿ, ರಿಯಾಯಿತಿಯನ್ನು ರಿಯಾಯಿತಿ ಖಾತೆಗೆ ಖರ್ಚು ಹಾಕಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

problem.en: Tunga Ltd. issued 5,000, 10% debentures of ₹100 each at a premium of 5%, payable in full on application. All were subscribed. Pass journal entries.

steps.en: Bank A/c Dr ₹5,25,000; To Debenture Application and Allotment A/c ₹5,25,000.
Debenture Application and Allotment A/c Dr ₹5,25,000; To 10% Debentures A/c ₹5,00,000; To Securities Premium A/c ₹25,000.

narration.en: Let us work this out together, step by step.

say.en: Let us work this out together, step by step. Tunga Ltd. issued 5,000, 10 percent debentures of 100 rupees each at a premium of 5 percent, payable in full on application. All were subscribed. Pass journal entries.
Amount received equals 5,000 times 105 rupees equals 5,25,000 rupees.
Bank A over c Dr 5,25,000 rupees; To Debenture Application and Allotment A over c 5,25,000 rupees.
Debenture Application and Allotment A over c Dr 5,25,000 rupees; To 10 percent Debentures A over c 5,00,000 rupees; To Securities Premium A over c 25,000 rupees.
Check: debits 5,25,000 rupees equals credits 5,00,000 rupees plus 25,000 rupees.
So the answer is Debentures 5,00,000 rupees; Securities Premium 25,000 rupees.

problem.en: Hemavathi Ltd. issued 2,000, 9% debentures of ₹500 each at a discount of 4%, payable in full on application. Pass the entry for allotment.

steps.en: Debenture Application and Allotment A/c Dr ₹9,60,000; Discount on Issue of Debentures A/c Dr ₹40,000; To 9% Debentures A/c ₹10,00,000.

narration.en: Let us work this out together, step by step.

say.en: Let us work this out together, step by step. Hemavathi Ltd. issued 2,000, 9 percent debentures of 500 rupees each at a discount of 4 percent, payable in full on application. Pass the entry for allotment.
Issue price equals 500 rupees minus 20 rupees equals 480 rupees; cash received equals 2,000 times 480 rupees equals 9,60,000 rupees.
Discount equals 2,000 times 20 rupees equals 40,000 rupees.
Debenture Application and Allotment A over c Dr 9,60,000 rupees; Discount on Issue of Debentures A over c Dr 40,000 rupees; To 9 percent Debentures A over c 10,00,000 rupees.
So the answer is 9 percent Debentures 10,00,000 rupees; Discount 40,000 rupees.
